findings.title: Preserve the original successful skipped-transport branch
findings.explanation: The added nonfinite transport disjunct enters traction/heat work when the original muEffective>0 || kEffective>0 condition skipped it successfully. With gasMu=NaN, direct conductivity=0, IncludeTurbulence=false and valid allocated state, both versions return success=1/status=0; original five bulk outputs are finite but frozen B2 makes momentum XYZ and energy NaN. This is an old-success regression, not completion of a refused call. The new nonfinite_coefficients test currently expects the changed behavior.
findings.required_outcome: Restore the original successful branch selection and exact field bytes; revise the new test to compare that previously successful route. Completion changes must stay on previously incomplete routes.

findings.title: Finish periodic and positivity outputs without requiring a legacy status channel
findings.explanation: Numeric-failure blocks still call asm(trap) when gasRecord*Failure returns false. A plain GasStateView with speciesCount=0 necessarily has no species status channel, although all numerical inputs/output buffers are present. Nonfinite periodic bulk therefore aborts before either face is published; nonfinite consumed volume aborts before the bulk positivity factor is published. Removing only the subsequent return did not finish these terminal routes.
findings.required_outcome: Numeric-only terminal continuation must publish the original arithmetic on plain legacy state as well as mixture state. Preserve missing consumed-pointer/CUDA/IO errors and existing successful clamps/skips.

findings.title: Do not label a metadata-seeded enthalpy as evaluated terminal arithmetic
findings.explanation: The new B2 terminal consumer calls the B1 complete evaluateSpecies bundle, but that helper still substitutes invalidValue for missing-by-count h when Cp metadata is valid. With six real LinearCp coefficients backed and coefficientCount=5, species 1 has two declared coefficients, so Cp eligibility succeeds and completeCoefficients stays false. The actual backed c[2] formation enthalpy is never read. Diffusion publishes evaluated=true and enthalpyFlux=NaN instead of the formula result 90000. The existing count=1 probe misses this intermediate property-availability case. NASA7 has the analogous Cp-only (five coefficients) branch.
findings.required_outcome: The selected terminal enthalpy/energy consumer must execute the backed property formula after its old refusal, while retaining strict-trial metadata selection and successful Cp-only/generic material behavior. Do not broadly weaken every bundle consumer.

new_execution_scope: One two-case legacy terminal gap binary; one immutable-base/current transport success comparison; one backed partial-property enthalpy gap binary. No existing suite repeated.
